look.speaker: Sealed Gate
look.text: A colossal gate of dark, unmarked stone fills the far wall, warm to the touch despite the cold. No handle, no seam, no keyhole — nothing to press, pull, or pick. Whatever lies beyond it, it is not ready to be found.
look.text_zh: 一扇巨大的深色石門矗立在盡頭的牆面上，門上沒有任何刻痕。儘管四周寒冷，門面卻異常溫熱。沒有把手，沒有接縫，沒有鎖孔——沒有任何可以推、拉或撬動之處。無論門後藏著什麼，此刻都還不是被找到的時候。

listen.speaker: Sealed Gate
listen.text: Nothing. Not silence exactly — more like something on the other side is choosing not to be heard. You get the feeling Karneth knows you're here, and doesn't care.
listen.text_zh: 什麼也沒有。並不完全是寂靜——更像是門另一側的某個存在，選擇不被聽見。你有種感覺，卡奈斯知道你在這裡，只是毫不在意。
